items.q: A micrometer of least count 0.01 mm shows 15 mm on the barrel and 16 on the thimble. What is the measurement in mm?

items.q: A shaft is dimensioned 40 +0.05/-0.2 mm. What is the tolerance, in mm?

items.q: A hole measures 20.08 mm and its mating shaft 15.99 mm. What is the clearance, in mm?
items.s: Clearance = hole - shaft = 20.08 - 15.99 = 4.09 mm.

items.q: A sheet of thickness 1.5 mm is bent through 60 degrees about an inside radius of 2 mm. What is the bend allowance, in mm?
items.s: Bend allowance = (theta x pi / 180) x (R + T) = (60 x 3.1416/180) x (2 + 1.5) = 3.67 mm.

items.q: A vernier calliper has a main scale divided into millimetres and a vernier of 20 divisions. What is its least count in mm?

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Divider.

the graduated metal rule used for measuring and checking lengths
the tool used to scribe circles and arcs and to step off equal distances
a hammer with one flat face and one rounded end used for riveting and shaping
items.s: Divider: the tool used to scribe circles and arcs and to step off equal distances. The other options describe Steel rule, Ball pein hammer, Scriber.

a fit in which the hole is always larger than the shaft so the parts move
the smallest value an instrument can read
the machine that turns the work against a cutting tool to produce cylindrical shapes

the appliance used to put out a small fire before it spreads
the protective eyewear worn to keep chips and dust out of the eyes
the cover fitted over moving parts to prevent contact and injury

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Gas welding.

welding in which a flame from burning fuel gas and oxygen supplies the heat
joining metals with a filler that melts above four hundred and fifty degrees but below the parent metal
joining metals with a low melting point filler metal that does not melt the parent metal

the control that cuts power to a machine immediately in an emergency
a written rule that governs conduct and safe practice in the workshop
the habit of keeping the workplace clean, clear and free of hazards

Fire extinguisher

a calliper with one bent leg used to scribe lines parallel to an edge
a block with a V groove used to hold round work steady for marking or drilling
